title: Can you look big with a small frame? (practical advice)
summary: Speaking from his own narrow-shouldered, short-clavicle, 36-inch-waist frame, NH gives practical strategies for looking big. Expand the ribcage with pullovers, build the abs, grow big legs and arms, develop side and rear delts and the triceps long head, embrace an X-taper and use open poses. Bulk slowly because waist fat looks worse on narrow frames, and train the obliques rather than avoid them.
claims: He has very narrow shoulders with very short clavicles, yet looks wide shirtless through muscle
There's no secret: to look big you must actually get big, slowly bulking up
Pullovers made the biggest difference to his physique: they build the lats and triceps long head and expand the ribcage, making a narrow lifter look wider and thicker
A wide V-taper is a genetic gift; narrow-framed lifters can look good but won't replicate it
Narrow-framed lifters must develop their abs: brace on compounds and also isolate the abs, because the waist is the centre of attention
Without his abs his physique would look terrible; they draw attention to the look of the waist rather than its size
The bigger your legs, the smaller your waist looks; legs are crucial for narrow frames
Big legs don't make a developed upper body look smaller much because it is further away
Develop side and rear delts and the triceps long head to add width in front poses
Narrow-framed lifters should avoid closed poses with arms near the trunk, which expose narrow shoulders; use open, expanded poses
Embrace the X-taper with massive limbs, which pull attention away from the torso, instead of betting everything on the shoulders
Some extra body fat can help a narrow frame look full, but every inch on the waist looks terrible, so bulk slowly
Squats, deadlifts and oblique training don't widen the waist; the waist is mostly hip bone structure and obliques mostly add definition
Developing his obliques made his waist look better; he has never seen someone make love handles worse by training
Whatever your bone structure, you can look big naturally
exercises: expands ribcage, builds lats and triceps long head; biggest difference to his physique
defined core is essential for narrow frames
defines and solidifies waist; doesn't widen it
